name: The Lantern House
public: A converted brick firehouse used as a local Lantern office, clinic, archive, and very imperfect safehouse.
secret: The basement contains a sealed room from the prior cell’s hospital-haunting case.

name: Saint Arden Emergency
public: A busy teaching hospital where Dr. Victor Shaw works nights.
secret: The oldest elevator occasionally opens onto a nonphysical “service floor” after deaths with unresolved supernatural causes.

name: Westway Mall
public: A mostly abandoned suburban mall with redevelopment signs that never quite lead to redevelopment.
secret: One of the Glass Market’s most reliable local manifestations appears here after midnight.

name: Platform Zero
public: A transit platform absent from official maps.
secret: It is a liminal junction linking several supernatural transit routes and one Veil-anchor maintenance path.

name: The Blue Hour
public: A stylish nightclub favored by Pale Court clients and ordinary professionals who think they are being adventurous.
secret: The VIP threshold is bound to Court hospitality law.

name: The Rook Building
public: Aster Vale Risk’s glass-and-steel regional headquarters.
secret: Three basement levels are missing from public plans; one houses the Forecast Lab.

name: Kestrel Data Annex
public: A municipal data center and traffic-control facility.
secret: Mina hid part of Morrowline’s refusal-training set in redundant traffic archives.

name: Riverside Marker 14
public: An old stone marker beside a levee trail.
secret: It records the original land covenant in a symbolic legal language Mother Juniper can interpret.

name: Mercy House
public: Father Ortiz’s sanctuary and mutual-aid center.
secret: Its basement threshold becomes unusually stable during Veil disturbances.

name: Harridan & Patel
public: A small law office handling property, contracts, and several clients who prefer not to be photographed.
secret: Samir keeps a physically handwritten index of supernatural contract precedents off-site.

name: The Municipal Archive
public: A public archive beneath the old courthouse.
secret: A restricted sublevel contains the chain-of-title documents for the local Veil anchors.

name: Crown & Ash Townhouse
public: Historic property used by the Pale Court for formal meetings.
secret: Regent Celene’s covenant fragment can temporarily disable one anchor safeguard from here.

name: Switchyard 19
public: Rail, fiber, power, and drainage infrastructure converge in one fenced industrial corridor.
secret: The Choir treats the junction as a sacred crossroads.

name: Linden Community Gardens
public: A thriving garden network on land repeatedly targeted for development.
secret: Mother Juniper can open a Green path from the oldest tool shed.

name: The Meridian Hotel
public: An aging downtown hotel with more conference rooms than guests.
secret: The Glass Market sometimes occupies an entire impossible mezzanine during major auctions.

name: Foxglove Storage
public: Self-storage facility near the highway.
secret: Lantern evidence lockers occupy three units under false company names.

name: Old Bell Telephone Exchange
public: A decommissioned switching building.
secret: Switchboard’s seven component spirits can be addressed separately here.

name: Aster Vale Safe Apartment
public: A furnished corporate lease in an ordinary residential tower.
secret: Used to isolate defectors, witnesses, or consultants under “protective relocation.”

name: North River Pump Station
public: Mundane flood-control infrastructure on the river.
secret: One of three local anchor sites is physically threaded through the pump station’s oldest foundation.

name: The Museum Annex
public: A climate-controlled storage building for artifacts not currently on display.
secret: The Civic Anomaly Unit’s pre-Veil artifact was quietly moved here under a false accession number.

name: County Morgue B
public: Older morgue wing where Owen works nights.
secret: The refrigeration grid overlaps a grave-resonance current and attracts unusually coherent ghosts.

name: Red Line Memorial
public: An informal cluster of flowers, transit cards, and names at a station wall.
secret: The “Saint of the Red Line” can manifest through the memorial during imminent transit deaths.

name: House 404
public: A detached house that appears on navigation systems only under specific conditions.
secret: Its legal address was magically stolen; the house exists in the gap created by missing ownership records.

name: The Anchor Chamber
public: A location the PC should not know at campaign start.
secret: The local Veil’s principal civic anchor is an impossible ritual structure layered through courthouse, transit, and river infrastructure rather than one room.
